classification.difficultyReason: Solve linear systems using substitution and elimination, including fractional coefficients and exact fractional solutions.

content.prompt: Solve each pair of simultaneous equations.

answer.worked:
Equate the expressions for $y$.
$$\begin{align*}3x+2&=x-4\\2x&=-6\\x&=-3\\y&=-3-4\\y&=-7\end{align*}$$
Check: $3(-3)+2=-7$ and $-3-4=-7$.

Equate the expressions for $y$.
$$\begin{align*}2-3x&=10+x\\-4x&=8\\x&=-2\\y&=10+(-2)\\y&=8\end{align*}$$
Check: $2-3(-2)=8$ and $10+(-2)=8$.

Equate the expressions for $y$.
$$\begin{align*}5-x&=10-2x\\5+x&=10\\x&=5\\y&=5-5\\y&=0\end{align*}$$
Check: $5-5=0$ and $10-2(5)=0$.

Add the equations to eliminate $y$.
$$\begin{align*}6x&=6\\x&=1\end{align*}$$
Substitute into $3x-y=2$.
$$\begin{align*}3(1)-y&=2\\-y&=-1\\y&=1\end{align*}$$
Check: $3(1)-1=2$ and $1+3(1)=4$.
